name: Yamaha MT-03
engine: 321 cc liquid-cooled parallel twin, fuel injected
intro: The naked version of the R3. 2020 bikes had a reflector recall and a VIN label recall.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. 2020 MT-03s are in recall 20V611 (rear reflector) and some in 21V048 (VIN on the certification label may not match the frame).
A-002.reason: Both fixes are free. A wrong VIN label can cause title trouble.

recalls.what: Condensation can collect on the rear reflector lens and make it less effective.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the rear reflector free.

recalls.what: VIN on the federal certification label may not match the frame.
recalls.fix: Dealer checks and replaces the label free.
